title: Dataset Manifest
description: Provenance record for a seeded Enterprise AI OS environment. Written by `eaios-seed seed`, returned by GET /dataset/manifest, and consumed by `eaios-seed verify` and CI. A manifest whose completed_at is null describes an incomplete environment (FR-014b).

schema_version.description: Bumped only on a breaking change to this schema.

root_seed.description: Root seed from which every generator sub-seed is derived (research R3).

reference_date.description: Pinned generation date. All temporal data derives from it; no wall clock is read (research R2).

generator_version.description: Version of the seed generator. A change here legitimately changes the fingerprint.

profile.description: Volume profile. `full` matches the spec volumes in FR-020b; `smoke` is a reduced set for fast CI.

companies.description: The seeded tenants. Exactly two in this feature.

entity_counts.description: Realized row count per entity family, keyed "{company_slug}.{family}" for tenant-owned families and "global.{family}" for allowlisted ones (FR-016, FR-020b).

family_digests.description: SHA-256 digest per entity family, computed from order-independent sorted row digests (research R5). Enables naming which family drifted on mismatch.

root_fingerprint.description: SHA-256 over the sorted family digests plus the files digest. Two runs with identical seed and reference date MUST produce identical values (FR-011, SC-002).

fingerprint_exclusions.description: Documented exclusion list required by FR-015a. Kept deliberately minimal; created_at/updated_at are NOT excluded because they are set deterministically from the reference clock.

started_at.description: Wall-clock start of the seed run. Excluded from the fingerprint — it is run metadata, not dataset content.

completed_at.description: Written last, in the same transaction as the fingerprint. Null means the run did not finish and the environment MUST be treated as incomplete (FR-014b, FR-014c).

duration_seconds.description: Observed seed duration. Reported against the SC-008 budget of 600 seconds.

host_platform.description: OS the seed ran on. Recorded for cross-platform determinism diagnosis; excluded from the fingerprint.
